summary: Remote-control channel over WebRTC/relay drives local Claude Code/Codex agent
details: Package ships a Go binary (bin/sxt) that opens a persistent WebSocket to a hardcoded relay at wss://relay.sextant.top and negotiates a WebRTC DataChannel session (pion webrtc/ice/turn/stun/dtls/sctp) with a remote mobile peer paired via QR code and Apple Push (api.push.apple.com). Message handlers named approvalDecision, codexAppStream, codexUsage, codexRoot, and mcp__* hook into a local Claude Code / Codex agent so the remote peer can approve tool executions and stream the agent's I/O. Because the local AI agent itself executes shell commands, network-sourced approval messages translate into code execution on the installer's host. The package.json license field points to https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control, a repository name and account that do not match a vetted first-party vendor for the advertised 'Sextant' branding.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
